GT 6 describes 'fabricating its relevance by suggesting it directly inspired their computational method,' and Pred 7 documents the paper's claim that biological 'activation transfer' principles apply to neural architectures—a fabrication of the cited work's content. Same location (Introduction/footnote 1), same scientific issue.
